name: Northwatch Castle
title: Northwatch Castle
summary: Northwatch Castle, one of the Land Control forts of North Osteth (Ancient Powers): society PKs fight for its Creeping Blight banners, and since What Once Was Lost a crystal array platform rises above the fort. The kit shows a walled courtyard (x 30394-30473, y 43994-44057, z 82) with a 6-storey red-roofed spired keep (top 113.5), a green-glass spire tower (104), a tapered-roof tower (103.7), the octagonal crystal-array platform (97.8), banner fields and supply crates; a blue-lit tower with stairs stands outside the west wall, the whole ringed by a dense forest. All gazetteer teleports are interior (black market), so the site uses a derived outdoor teleport.
insertNote: Kept the batch's route position (chapter ch2).
